about: Hand decisions about MH3 stat blocks, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py after scripts/msh/coverpanels.py parses them. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, label}: a card or one-line grid; page is the printed Adventure page, header the start of the entry's header, label the block's own label where it has one
verdict   as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why

text              match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed 15, the card: every rank Typical, so F+A+S+E is 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24, and the card prints Health 150 and Karma varies. The android has a Health of 150 whatever it has absorbed (the form on printed 9 says so). Nate, 2026-10-21 (survey mh3.md decision 7): kept as printed (not taken: derive 24).
